quote.exact: is a system composed of two detection modules based on the AX-PET concept

quote.exact: is composed of 48 axially oriented LYSO scintillation crystals of dimension 3 × 3 × 100 mm3 (six layers with eight crystals per layer)

quote.exact: The crystal layers are interleaved with orthogonal wave length shifting (WLS) plastic strips

quote.exact: For all elements light output was measured using Geiger-mode avalanche photo-diodes, also referred to as silicon photo multipliers (SiPMs)

quote.exact: single crystal energy resolution was 11.8% (FWHM) at 511 keV

quote.exact: Triple interactions are those for which there are three measurements in total (at least one measurement per head) with no event ambiguity

annotations.note: Triples: three resolved interactions, at least one per head

quote.exact: triple interaction measurements with multiplicity [1, 2] or [2, 1] will provide only two candidate LoRs
